title: MacOS Startup
description: Replaces the default Mojang loading screen with the MacOS startup screen.
body: ## **What does it do** - Replaces the default loading screen with a MacOS loading screen ## **Quick Info** - **Required Dependencies: [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)** ## **How it's going to look** ![Quick Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af18e7436bbd7d4df2ce187dead9fc6a761704d2_0.webp) ## **Other** - If you find a bug or would like to suggest something, do so on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/BNMWP4Xaxg)
